facts.fact: 醒来失能：scattered/marbles/jumble of sensation/fuzz hissing——被绑在震动水泥台上（electric chair 般 humming）——「mid-disintegration」；呛咳吐沫、眼皮粘住——「Maybe I'm a tourist inside it. A brief voyeur, squinting through a peephole I never should have found.」——喉咙管 sputters like vacuum cleaner——「Whose chin? Whose body is this?」——名字查无（「the answer's totally inaccessible」）

想回去：想 season finale 下一场（王座对峙/惊喜死亡）——「Please let me become Aries again, I negotiate with this mind I'm stuck inside. Please let me be television.」——无效（「usually it's effortless…Float between characters and plotlines. Cue the London Symphony Orchestra.」）——身体感：bloated/raw/rotting plum——pilot in an oversized cockpit——用意志睁眼

定位：刺眼亮光=熟悉的灯光——「This is the hospital. This is Public Access Afterworld: the place where my patient body lives when it's not living inside its TV show. I've woken up in the middle of one of my therapy sessions.」——管子吸电视：蛋形容器（thick clear plastic、嵌天花板又向上延伸）收所有 TV signals——数千管子从蛋垂下，一根插进自己喉咙，其余=同房病友喉咙——「No. None of them are awake…They're still transmitting, still asleep.」

空中波芭蕾：躺看别人信号入蛋、ballet 般旋转——能辨出 individual pictures（people/places/scenes）——「Look: There's The Honeymooners. There's The Andy Griffith Show. There's Sex and the fucking City.」——找到自己的 The Wolves of Birmingham 回放（Previously On/CGI credits/second line parade/化妆室 glitch 场）——诊断：「a signal intrusion. I lost my focus…picked up a signal. The random fragments of memories that weren't my own…a disturbance, something from far away, from outside the realm」——「My TV show is supposed to be a closed circuit…continuity exact」——「This is the bottom of the universe. The fidelity down here is so low that it's all scrambles. Everything runs on autopilot so we patients can focus on what really matters. Doing our therapy. Making our TV shows. Expelling our sickness.」

再入睡：管子如牙钻/吸空奶昔的 straw——闭眼想象王座对峙、inner eyelids 反复播放——「I feel myself drifting away…ditch this pesky sentience and channel that glowing light inside me until I become it.」——「Right before I'm all the way gone, I hear the faint sound of the tube inside me wrapping its tendrils around my signal. The straw, refinding its milkshake. The sound calms me down, because I know it means I'm transmitting again. I leave the hospital behind. I enter the throne room.」
